meaning: Some entries are source-internal conflicts; others are scientifically important distinctions or extraction hazards, not corrections to the authors.

items.subject: Star-film composition
items.evidence: MAIN p3 body calls it SbTe; Fig3b caption says GeSbTe
items.required_handling: Do not choose one silently. Require certified specimen identity before fabrication/interpretation.

items.subject: Blu-ray feature naming
items.evidence: MAIN body and SEM labels show 200 nm lines and 100 nm gaps; caption calls 100 nm lines
items.required_handling: Store line width and gap separately; treat figure caption wording as unresolved labeling rather than changing geometry.

items.subject: Experimental versus modeled gold
items.evidence: 20 nm porous experimental gold in Methods versus 40 nm film in Fig4 model
items.required_handling: Different reported systems; no assumption that model thickness is the experimental thickness.

items.subject: SIL geometry and objectives
items.evidence: Experimental half-ball controls differ from model H=a(1+1/n) SIL; 0.5 mm uses 80x, 2.5 mm uses 40x
items.required_handling: No fully matched pure-shape control; preserve physical and model identities.

items.subject: Magnification evidence categories
items.evidence: Measured grating 4.17x and AAO about 8x; heuristic about 5.5x; Poynting construction 2-4x
items.required_handling: Do not combine into one validated forward model or use these source outcomes as enforced pass thresholds.

items.subject: Headline versus figure-supported scope
items.evidence: 50 nm illustrated for gold/AAO transmission. Both-mode 50 nm and complex transmission are text-only claims
items.required_handling: Source reading complete does not upgrade the evidence class. Keep extensions visibly unverified.

items.subject: Figure-caption quantity mismatch
items.evidence: Fig4c caption mentions FWHM but panel plots normalized intensity versus x/a
items.required_handling: Treat curves as intensity profiles, not a supplied table of measured FWHM. No digitization here.

items.subject: Equation extraction artifact
items.evidence: Text extraction drops radicals in Eq1; visual PDF shows sqrt(2) as branch boundary and inside the denominator
items.required_handling: Source not amended; any future formula transcription must use the visual original and qualified math review.

items.subject: Pore spacing and virtual calibration
items.evidence: Source gives 50 nm pores/50 nm spacing and 400 nm image-plane feature; no full traceable coordinate model
items.required_handling: Do not silently equate edge gap, pitch, pore diameter and optical period.

items.subject: Large-area composition
items.evidence: Paper discusses combining images from a self-assembled lens array, without supplying an algorithm, registration or quantitative mosaic test
items.required_handling: Preserve as concept, not a completed stitched image, demonstrated field coverage or verified robot capability.
